column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the katas warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Workstreams: A Directory Is One When It Carries a Queue, Dot-Named Ones Never Are, and the Names Come Back Sorted
The Detached Commit: The mikemol-commit Argv Names Only What Was Asked, and a Log Reads Running, Done or Failed From Its Last rc Line
The Waiter: A Command's Output Then rc=N Lands in Its Log, a Timeout Is Recorded as 124, and the Cleanup Runs Whatever the Result
The Detached Start: The Waiter Argv Carries the Log, the Cleanup Pairs and the Command, and a Started Command's Log Reads Running Then Done
